ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with localized mid-to-high intensity (light gray) regions; macro-level ratio estimated at approximately 80:20 dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region across the central and left fluke surface; right lobe exhibits a high-contrast gradient from light gray base to dark distal edges with high-frequency dark speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees; apex depth is partially obscured by low-intensity water splash but suggests a significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude irregularity and jaggedness on the right lobe trailing edge; fine-scale serrations with 2-5 pixel amplitude are visible across the remaining continuous portions of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of high-intensity circular rings (rosettes) detected near distal tips; a dense constellation of ~15-20 circular marks is visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of at least three parallel, dark linear disruptions (rake marks) observed on the mid-right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic tissue loss and irregular notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe, including a major semi-circular missing segment; multiple smaller chips present on the left lobe distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical morphology characterized by the heavily frayed and damaged trailing edge of the right lobe compared to the more intact trailing edge of the left lobe.
